messages:
maria.g: Found plaintext AWS access key in partner-Y debug dump we pulled for troubleshooting. Key ends with: XZ2P. DM'ing raw to @noah and dropping redacted line here.

sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-044 opened. Evidence archived to s3://redwood-secure/incidents/SEC-2026-044/ (immutable snapshot created).

maria.g: Redacted sample: `2026-03-24T02:14:01Z INFO webhook.debug partner=partner-y file=s3://partner-uploads/y/2026-03-24/dump.log access_key=AKIA************XZ2P`

noah: Initial plan: 1) contain (pause partner pipeline), 2) run CloudTrail for AccessKeyId, 3) revoke and delete key, 4) check Vault/KMS envelope keys and rewrap if used, 5) rotate any Terraform/CI artifacts. @ops-oncall pause ingestion.

ops-oncall: Pausing now. `kubectl -n ingest scale deploy/partner-y-consumer --replicas=0` -> scaled at 02:16 UTC.

vault-bot: Scanning Vault mounts for partner-y entries: running `vault kv list secret/partners` and `vault kv get -format=json secret/partners/partner-y` on behalf of @infra-lee. Marking any found entries for rotation.

infra-lee: I'll run quick grep across infra repos: `git grep -n "AKIA" -- '*.tf' '*.yaml'` and scan CI artifact storage. If matches, we'll rotate and purge.

noah: Revoke steps (AWS): `aws iam update-access-key --user-name ingest-partner-y --access-key-id AKIA...XZ2P --status Inactive` then `aws iam delete-access-key --user-name ingest-partner-y --access-key-id AKIA...XZ2P`. Also run `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=AccessKeyId,AttributeValue=AKIA...XZ2P --start-time 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z` and save to evidence bucket.

maria.g: DM'd raw artifact to @noah and to @legal-sue for PII check.

noah: Vault/KMS decision: if partner artifacts were envelope-encrypted with our CMK/transit key, create new envelope key and re-encrypt. Prefer rewrap-on-read + background rewrap-runner. Owner: infra-lee.

infra-lee: Creating new transit key `partner-y-transit-v2` and wiring rewrap-runner. ETA: key + smoke test ~90m. Will post request_id in incident folder.

noah: For medium-term fix, switch partner integration to role-based STS via Vault aws secrets engine (no long-lived keys). @infra-lee prepare Terraform PR to: - create IAM role ingest-partner-y-role - add vault aws role partner-y-ingest - update deployment to obtain creds at runtime. Add org constraint to deny creating long-lived keys for that SA.

ops-oncall: After new creds and CI config validated, I will coordinate unpause and staged rollout (canary in prod).

vault-bot: Found `secret/partners/partner-y/aws-creds` ciphertext. Marked for rotate; set lease TTL to 1h for new role. Scheduled rotate job after rewrap.

legal-sue: Confirmed no PII in the sampled file. Logged chain-of-custody in incident folder, retaining logs for 90 days for this case.

noah: Owners & timeline: containment (0-30m) = ops; evidence & scope (0-2h) = noah + infra-lee; rotate & rewrap (1-4h) = infra-lee; rollout to role-based STS + org policy (3-12h) = infra-lee + devops; postmortem (24-72h) = maria.g + legal-sue.

maria.g: Running additional scans across partner buckets and internal backups for any other leaked keys. Starting `gsutil` and `s3` artifact scans now.

sec-bot: Incident status -> containment in progress. Evidence frozen and versioned.

noah: Keep updates here. Once rewrap job begins, mark channel and we'll run regression tests in staging before unpausing. :thumbsup:
